issues.issue: Unexplained line is 66.6% of governmental receipts in 'other'. Nothing on the form says what it is; for an agricultural society it is probably fair/event income (charges for services/fees). Marked review, but it needs a person's call.

An unexplained line that is most of the year's receipts belongs in decision_needed[], which the extraction does not have. A person should confirm it is fair/event income and not loan proceeds or something else.

The form doesn't split this unspecified debt service line into principal and interest. The extractor recorded it as interest/fees; the budget-form rule for combined debt payments uses debt service principal. Judgment call, marked review.
